assessment.nobel_worthiness: Densely patterned, visionary prose that treats memory, the body and dream as an extended metaphysical project. Blinding and Solenoid show unusual imaginative range and formal ambition, and the voice is distinctive. Judged here by sustained quality and intellectual depth rather than by fame or prizes.
assessment.attribution: The entry names a single writer working in fiction and poetry in Romanian. A citation could cover the whole project of an inner cosmology built from the body and memory, rather than a single work.
assessment.maturity: A long, cumulative oeuvre in which the large prose works appear to extend earlier motifs. The case rests on the whole body of work, which fits the consideration of an entire authorship.
uncertainties: Judgments on Romanian prose depend heavily on translation, and the density of the style may not carry over fully.
My knowledge of the poetry and earlier work is thinner than of the major novels.
No texts were re-read or independently verified for this assessment.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Dreamlike narrative worlds that destabilize ordinary psychology, space and causality. The voice is highly distinctive and comparatively unlike most contemporary fiction. The formal radicalism seems to be an integral part of the imaginative vision, not a surface device.
assessment.attribution: A single writer working in Chinese fiction. A citation could cover a sustained experimental project that rejects conventional realist storytelling, with Frontier and Love in the New Millennium as representative works.
assessment.maturity: Decades of consistent output suggest a durable and coherent aesthetic. How far the later work deepens, rather than repeats, the earlier mode is harder to judge.
uncertainties: The work is very dependent on translation, and coverage of the English-language corpus is partial.
I cannot judge from this evidence whether the later work develops the method or merely repeats it.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Hybrid works that remake the boundaries between classical scholarship, lyric, narrative and visual form. Autobiography of Red and Nox are inventive and formally original, with real intellectual depth. A strong case on distinctiveness of voice and formal achievement.
assessment.attribution: A single writer in poetry, essays and drama in English. A citation would likely centre on formal reinvention across genres and the dialogue with antiquity.
assessment.maturity: A substantial body of work spanning decades and several forms. Quality seems sustained, but some of the oeuvre is deliberately fragmentary and occasional.
uncertainties: Because the work is so often hybrid or experimental, it is difficult to say how much of the oeuvre is central rather than peripheral.
The work is heavily intertextual, so its significance may depend on the reader's familiarity with classical sources.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Remade Arabic poetic language through myth, fragmentation and sustained dialogue with inherited forms. Songs of Mihyar the Damascene and A Time Between Ashes and Roses are widely cited in this context. The linguistic and formal achievement is significant, and the scope of the poetry and essays is broad.
assessment.attribution: A single writer in poetry and essays in Arabic. A citation could concern the renewal of Arabic poetic language and form across a long career.
assessment.maturity: A very long career with documented influence on later poetry. The judgment is that the formal importance is established; how far the later work keeps its force is less clear.
uncertainties: Arabic poetry in translation loses much of its prosodic and linguistic achievement, so my assessment is necessarily indirect.
My coverage of the later poetry and the essays is limited.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Large, polyphonic narratives that remake the novel through Indigenous sovereignty, oral forms and ecological time. Carpentaria and The Swan Book show ambitious scale and an original narrative architecture. The voice is distinctive and the vision has intellectual depth.
assessment.attribution: A single writer in fiction and nonfiction in English. A citation could concern the renewal of the novel through Aboriginal storytelling and political imagination.
assessment.maturity: The body of fiction is comparatively small, though substantial in scale. Whether it is yet broad enough to rest a full prize on is open to debate.
uncertainties: The number of major novels is limited, which affects any judgment of sustained quality across an oeuvre.
Some of the nonfiction is outside my coverage.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Uncanny narrative voices that expose exclusion, family power and unstable belonging. Three Strong Women and My Heart Hemmed In display a precise and unsettling prose style and an original handling of the uncanny within realist settings. Distinctive voice and formal control.
assessment.attribution: A single writer in fiction and drama in French. A citation could concern a body of work in which estrangement and social power are explored through narrative strangeness.
assessment.maturity: An established oeuvre across novels and plays. The later work seems to maintain quality, though I cannot fully assess its development.
uncertainties: My coverage of the plays relative to the novels is uneven.
Translation may affect the perceived tone and the restraint of the prose.
No texts were re-read or independently verified for this assessment.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Dense, compressed prose that transforms obscure lives and art history into powerful narrative inquiry. Small Lives and The Eleven are cited for linguistic intensity and formal economy. The achievement is in the style and language, and the depth lies in its concentration.
assessment.attribution: A single writer of fiction and essays in French. A citation could concern the creation of a distinctive prose of compression and the fiction of lives.
assessment.maturity: The oeuvre is small in volume but highly concentrated. This may favor depth over breadth when judging sustained achievement.
uncertainties: The slimness of the oeuvre raises the question of whether it is broad enough for the prize.
The stylistic qualities are hard to carry across in translation, and English coverage is limited.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Interlinked Indigenous narratives that join communal memory, legal power and inventive storytelling. Love Medicine and The Night Watchman show a long-running, interconnected fictional world and a strong narrative voice. The sustained scale and the range of voices are notable.
assessment.attribution: A single writer in fiction and poetry in English. A citation could concern the creation of a many-novel fictional community that renews American narrative through Anishinaabe experience.
assessment.maturity: A long and prolific career with substantial recognition. The unevenness across such a large output is something I cannot fully weigh.
uncertainties: The size of the oeuvre makes the consistency of quality hard to judge from selective knowledge.
My coverage of the poetry relative to the novels is limited.
